head: f3d543efef1900c1276c03f6cef112a1f6da2a4c
title: Expire sessions after a day and drop legacy tokens

waiting.title: Every session older than a day ends
waiting.detail: Users signed in before the deploy sign in again on their next request.

risks.title: Long-lived sessions end at once
risks.impact: The first request after the deploy signs out everyone whose session is older than 24 hours.

areas.name: Security
areas.summary: Sessions expire after 24 hours, and the base64 token path is gone.

after.text: Tell support that users sign in again after the deploy

decisions.question: Is a 24-hour limit in `src/auth/session.ts` right for the storefront?
decisions.why: Every session older than a day ends on its next request.
decisions.suggestion: Yes for staff; check with support before shoppers see it.
